episode_notes:
Episode Map & Payoff Beats:
- L0001-L0134: Vaishnavi & Prasad cafe breakup confrontation. Vaishnavi lists his bizarre gifts and embarrassing blunders (ORS, death anniversary bouquet, railway station date). Payoff beats: L0052 (punchline), L0126 (punchline).
- L0135-L0272: Prasad meets Bhramara (madam/driver dynamic). Discussion on philophobia, father's permission, and therapy. Payoff beats: L0189 (punchline), L0268 (punchline).
- L0273-L0345: Prasad with an ex who reveals she is married; her lawyer husband Paramajyothi arrives. Payoff beat: L0343 (reveal).
- L0346-L0437: Prasad flirts with Bhramara; gets caught repeating the same lines to multiple girls. Payoff beat: L0385 (punchline).
- L0438-L0540: Pratheeksha calls Prasad; in the cafe she brother-zones him. Payoff beat: L0501 (punchline).
- L0541-L0611: Prasad at Pratyusha's house; Pooja exposes his double-timing between Bhramara and Pratyusha. Payoff beat: L0591 (emotional_peak).
- L0612-L0645: Bhramara shares her family trauma with Prasad, giving him a clue about his own parents.
- L0646-L0720: Vaishnavi and her lawyer husband Paramajyothi argue while riding; intense bickering. Payoff beat: L0693 (punchline).
- L0721-L0776: Prasad meets Bhramara at coconut stall, mocking her upcoming arranged marriage and her teetotaler groom. Payoff beat: L0776 (punchline).
- L0777-L0853: Prasad talks to Virajitha, proposes randomly and mocks her lawyer fiance. Payoff beat: L0811 (punchline).
- L0854-L0884: Family panchayati with Pooja and Prasad's parents. Payoff beat: L0877 (punchline).
- L0885-L0920: Climax twists: Bhramara cancels her wedding for Prasad (L0897, reveal), followed by Pratyusha's obsessive warning phone call (L0918, emotional_peak cliffhanger).
